binding: event.target.closest("[data-action]"); read dataset.action, dataset.id, dataset.tab; disabled native buttons stay inactive

actions.name: depart
actions.meaning: 营地主出战，打开出发确认

actions.name: stages
actions.meaning: 选卷页面/出发确认前往择卷

actions.name: chooseStage
actions.meaning: ST01–ST06，根保留锁定卷上下文

actions.name: prepare
actions.meaning: 所选ST的整备

actions.name: chooseRoute
actions.meaning: RT稳定ID，替换当前配招选择

actions.name: start
actions.meaning: 启动青溪代表表现旅程

actions.name: select
actions.meaning: 卡/觉醒/器物取舍ID；仅选择

actions.name: confirmChoice
actions.meaning: 确认当前具名选择，由根切固定后样本

actions.name: detail
actions.meaning: 稳定内容ID或utility ID；打开详情

actions.name: close
actions.meaning: 关闭顶层modal并恢复所选上下文

actions.name: back
actions.meaning: 根返回栈

actions.name: pause
actions.meaning: 保留choice/playing上下文

actions.name: resume
actions.meaning: 显式恢复刚才上下文

actions.name: settings
actions.meaning: 声音与画面

actions.name: toggleMute
actions.meaning: 由根切静音标志与声音表现

actions.name: toggleReduced
actions.meaning: 由根切减少动态标志

actions.name: restart
actions.meaning: 打开restartConfirm

actions.name: confirmRestart
actions.meaning: 根重置本次表现旅程

actions.name: revive
actions.meaning: free；本版只一次免费复起

actions.name: declineRevive
actions.meaning: 进入独立失败结算固定情景

actions.name: settle
actions.meaning: 结束行路结算

actions.name: returnCamp
actions.meaning: 根应用固定归营后样本

actions.name: growth
actions.meaning: 营地修行

actions.name: chooseGrowth
actions.meaning: UP稳定ID

actions.name: previewUpgrade
actions.meaning: UP/CO稳定ID，打开upgradeConfirm

actions.name: confirmPreview
actions.meaning: UP/CO稳定ID，切固定培养后样本

actions.name: gear
actions.meaning: 器物；data-tab=current/last/codex

actions.name: chooseGear
actions.meaning: GE稳定ID

actions.name: companions
actions.meaning: 同行伙伴

actions.name: chooseCompanion
actions.meaning: CO稳定ID

actions.name: codex
actions.meaning: 图鉴；data-tab=skills/enemies

actions.name: chooseEntry
actions.meaning: SK/EN/EL/BO稳定ID

actions.name: achievements
actions.meaning: 功绩，已达成自动入账说明

actions.name: claimPreview
actions.meaning: ad；可选加领情景，非逐条功绩领取

actions.name: help
actions.meaning: 须知/恢复说明

actions.name: retryLoad
actions.meaning: 原界面重试载入设计情景

actions.name: retrySave
actions.meaning: 原结算重试记录设计情景

actions.name: cancel
actions.meaning: 保存失败保留同一候选返回；冲突按Root只读返回，其他回原层

actions.name: refreshChoice
actions.meaning: 整局免费换组设计样本；fixture.refreshRemaining 2→1→0，不换offer编号；Root唯一提交者

actions.name: previewOperation
actions.meaning: OP稳定ID；可附data-subject当前CO、data-variant=declineBoth；Root解析A literal并打开现有upgradeConfirm

actions.name: confirmOperation
actions.meaning: 提交当前同operation/subject/variant的预写after一次；UI不计算

actions.name: toggleCompanion
actions.meaning: CO稳定ID；Root解析同行/暂歇literal，仍走共用确认层

reviewControls: nextBeat/collect are review-shell actions, absent from product HUD
modalContext: state.modal overlays state.screen; inert underlay; Root owns focus restoration, return stack and scroll positions

newDetailIds.RESULT-SOURCES: Read fixture.result.base/firstExtra/achievementExtra/total only; no additional reward claim

gearStepEvents.previewOperation OP-GEAR-OPPORTUNITY var: Root完全匹配A literal HP/机会项，不执行通用治疗
gearStepEvents.confirmChoice with gearReceipt: 明确继续下一段，不再次提交
